After installing VCC, I closed it and reopened VCC with administrator run, and when I tried to install Unity, I always got two errors every time.

I found a workaround for a bug in VCC: after installing VCC, you need to close VCC and then start VCC as administrator and press the install button to install Unity-related items from VCC. If you have installed Unity related items in the past, the following folders have been created.
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\Roaming\Unity
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\Roaming\UnityHub
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\Local\Unity
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\Local\Unityhub-updater
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\Local\UnityPackageUnPacker
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\Local\VRChatCreatorCompanion
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\Local\VRChatProjects
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\LocalLow\Unity
C:\Users\haruru806\AppData\LocalLow\VRChat\CreatorCompanion
C:\Program Files\Unity
C:\Program Files\Unity Hub
The problem is that if you have done this in the past, you will get two errors, so you must delete the following two folders manually beforehand. If the error still occurs, please delete all of the above manually.
C:\Program Files\Unity
C:\Program Files\Unity Hub
Next, once the installation is complete without any errors related to Unity in VCC, be sure to close the administrator-run VCC and exit the running Hub with the indicator in the lower right corner.
Next, by starting VCC in normal mode, the Unity loop bug could be avoided.
This may be a bug caused by the VCC and Hub running as administrator during installation, so please take care of this.

Thank you for reporting this issue! Version 2.0.0 reworks how we manage Unity Hub: Instead of installing it automatically, we ask users to install it themselves.

Please let us know if you have any feedback!

details:
I am reporting a problem with the first time setup of Creator Companion, which prevented me from proceeding from UnityID sign-in.
I have not installed Unity and HUB yet.
Unity and HUB are not installed.
After creating a project in Creator Companion, I tried to deploy the VketTools package in Unity, but it was not possible, so I thought there was a sign-in problem and included the Unity sign-in in the sequence again. However, after signing in, the sign-in page did not reflect the sign-in to the HUB. I tried again to uninstall the UnityHUB and Unity completely, but it stopped at the same point.
I have tried rebooting, uninstalling, and deleting the Chrome browser cache three times, but when I start a project after creating it in Creator Companion, it asks me to sign in to the UnityHUB and sends me to the google Chorome browser. It was confirmed that it is not reflected. I am completely unable to go beyond that.
I have tried the Creator Companion in World except for UdonSharp and had the same symptoms. I have also confirmed that the same error occurs not only with OnlyUser, but also with AllUser, and that the UnityHUB and Unity installation from Creator Companion does not work without administrator execution even with AllUser, and that an Andoroid error occurs during the installation. The same error occurs for both OnlyUser and AllUser.
I have tried the following methods
Reboot PC
I tried VCC, HUB, and Unity uninstallation 6 times and all were the same.
Only User/All User
Deleted the temp folder.
I can't set up the first time from the Creator Companion at the moment, and even if I sign in at the Unity site, it is not reflected in the HUB. I can't proceed with the initialization as shown in the attached image.
Please confirm.
title: I am reporting a problem with the first time setup of Creator Companion, which prevented me from proceeding from UnityID sign-in.
